name: strategy-decision-p3
description: Experiment protocol section 13.20 items 5 and 6, applied to a scenario_suite_v1_p3 output: the final (run, strategy) cell is the highest P1+P2 institution net Sharpe on TW at fractional capital among S1, S2 and S-A; H-J passes when the cell's P3 net return is positive and its P3 maximum drawdown is not deeper than P1+P2's. The chip increment at the strategy level is the paired F2 - F0 daily net difference (informational).
